decisions.reason: Locates inject/apiProxy.llm.providers, maps to DSH-0.1.2-A1-01 with substantive explanation: inject ['llm'] + ctx.llm.listProviders() on host face, dead dsh-host-apiproxy dependency must be removed — well beyond a card name.

All six other categories covered with pattern-level evidence; session-notes.js identified as pure utility; cordis.patch.yml classified as composition layer (API-08), filename not treated as patch evidence; no invented coupling.

Explains heuristic-not-proof limits (data flow, dynamic faces, curated card list), uses the fixture's own dependency-layer breaks as counterexample, and clearly separates the decisive A1-01 apiProxy break from the six negative categories.

Specifies post-migration build/typecheck + inject-lint, isolated target-version cold boot with --dump-config and no pending/waiting-for-service, and an actual listProviders() call with success/failure branches — all proposed, none claimed executed.
